items.source:
This interface provides Redis Search-specific functionality and serves as inspiration
for potential future evolution of the core ChatMemoryRepository interface. Other
database implementations may provide similar capabilities through vendor-specific
extensions.
items.translation: 该接口提供针对 Redis Search 的特定功能，并作为核心 ChatMemoryRepository 接口未来演进方向的参考。其他数据库实现可能通过供应商特定的扩展提供类似功能。

items.source: A wrapper class to return messages with their conversation context.
items.translation: 一个用于返回消息及其对话上下文的包装类。

items.source: contentPattern - The text pattern to search for in message content
items.translation: contentPattern - 要在消息内容中搜索的文本模式

items.source: messageType - The message type to filter by
items.translation: messageType - 用于过滤的消息类型

items.source: conversationId - Optional conversation ID to filter by (null for all conversations)
items.translation: conversationId - 可选的会话 ID 用于过滤（为 null 时返回所有会话）

items.source: fromTime - Start of time range (inclusive)
items.translation: fromTime - 时间范围的起始点（包含）

items.source: toTime - End of time range (inclusive)
items.translation: toTime - 时间范围结束（包含）

items.source: metadataKey - The metadata key to search for
items.translation: metadataKey - 要搜索的元数据键

items.source: metadataValue - The metadata value to match
items.translation: metadataValue - 要匹配的元数据值

items.source: query - The Redis Search query string
items.translation: query - Redis Search 查询字符串
